# Judson Tibbs

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Judson Tibbs is characterized by his pale, prominent eyes. His eyes feature a distinct, gleaming sparkle.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P51](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0051)_

## Personality

Judson is a cheerful and suave individual. Driven by the desire to secure Louisa [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) and her lucrative financial future, he harbors a strong fear of the disastrous consequences that would follow if he were exposed for taking a bribe.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065)_

## Traits

- being exposed for taking a bribe  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065)</sub>

- suave  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P42](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0042)</sub>

## Abilities

_Not yet known._

## Goals

- securing Louisa Odette  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065)</sub>

## History

Judson Tibbs faced opposition from a Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) delegation over his plan to lease his fences for medicine advertisements, but he steadfastly refused to change his mind. Shortly thereafter, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) accidentally overheard Judson accepting a political bribe from [Tobias Corcoran](../character/tobias-corcoran.md). To ensure Nell's silence about the bribe, Judson ultimately agreed to drop his fence advertising scheme.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P49](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0049), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_
